An astronomical object was the '''homeworld''' of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]] and his family. Due to it's backwater nature, it had never been visited by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 3" />
